question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is '**caused**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] ** __Key Points__ ** 

__
 
• The sentence requires the correct form of the verb to describe the result of an action.
 
• "Caused" is the correct option as it is the past tense of "cause," indicating an action that has already occurred.
 
• Other options ("cause," "causing," "causes") are either incorrect in tense or do not fit the grammatical structure of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] ** Additional Information__ ** 

 
• Cause: "Cause" is the base form of the verb and does not fit the past tense requirement.
 
• Causing: "Causing" is the present participle and does not align with the sentence structure.
 
• Causes: "Causes" is the present tense form and does not match the context of the sentence.
